scripts.build:sdk: npm run generate:protocol && npm run build --workspace @pamatcad/sdk
scripts.build: npm run build:core && npm run build:sdk
scripts.test:api: npm run build && tsc -p tests && node tests/run.mjs
scripts.build:web: npm run build:sdk && npm run build:wasm && npm run web -w @pamatcad/editor
scripts.build:desktop: npm run build:sdk && npm run desktop -w @pamatcad/editor
scripts.test:editor:desktop: npm run desktop-ui -w @pamatcad/editor && cargo run --locked --release --manifest-path apps/editor/src-tauri/Cargo.toml --features editor-smoke
